ideas.pitch: A localized job-matching platform designed for SVSU skill-based education graduates to instantly pair their hands-on training certifications with regional manufacturing and industrial needs.
ideas.title: SkillMap SVSU: On-Spot Skill-to-Job Matching Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses local vocational employment dynamics directly relevant to Shri Vishwakarma Skill University's mission, making it deeply resonant for university judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite image analysis platform that detects unauthorized industrial expansions and land-use compliance violations across regional industrial zones.
ideas.title: EcoAudit Haryana: Industrial Land Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages satellite monitoring patterns proven to win industrial hackathons while targeting actual state-level regulatory enforcement priorities.

ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade triage web application featuring rPPG touchless heart rate monitoring and multi-language support (Hindi/English) for campus health centers.
ideas.title: MedTriage SVSU: Multi-Language Campus Health Kiosk
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates complex real-time browser vision processing combined with immediate local healthcare utility, a proven winning formula.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight traceability ledger for local agricultural cooperatives in Haryana to track produce journey from farm to market with automated quality verification.
ideas.title: AgriTrace SVSU: Supply Chain Provenance Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a logistical problem heavily experienced by agrarian economies in northern India, ensuring high relevance to local stakeholders.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent mentorship retrieval platform that assists vocational students with technical query resolution based on practical training handbooks.
ideas.title: VocationalRAG: Apprenticeship Knowledge Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets educational support using advanced LangGraph and RAG patterns that judges appreciate for their technical execution.
